title: InvocationRequest
description: Body of an InvokeAgentRuntime call that the agent answers. A body that does not match is not an error: the agent returns an input_rejection, and it ignores properties it does not know.

prompt.description: The prompt. Trimmed before use. Must not be empty after trimming. The maximum length is the MaxPromptChars deployment parameter (4000 by default), measured after trimming.

actorId.description: Who is asking. Separates conversations in memory (feature 002). Treated as 'default' when absent or empty.
